lines.zh: 我一步一晃，像树枝在风里。
lines.en: I sway with each step, like a twig in wind.

lines.zh: 六条细腿，走起来没声音。
lines.en: Six thin legs, and my steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 我走过树干，没人看得出。
lines.en: I cross the trunk, and no one notices.

lines.zh: 我的腿抬得很高，落得很轻。
lines.en: My legs lift high and land lightly.

lines.zh: 逆着光走，我更像一根枝条。
lines.en: Against the light I look even more like a branch.

lines.zh: 我专挑有叶子的地方挪。
lines.en: I move only where the leaves are.
When the wind blows, I sway along.

lines.zh: 我先动一条腿，再动另一条。
lines.en: I move one leg, then the other.
The bark is the same color as I am.
I creep from the leaf's underside to its top.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为要装得像。
lines.en: I walk slowly, because I must look convincing.
This stretch of bark is a little slick.
I walk to the very end of the branch.
To change trees, I must judge the distance first.

lines.zh: 我挪到叶柄上，把腿伸直。
lines.en: I shift onto the leaf stem and stretch.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在枝头，我不动。
lines.en: A bird lands nearby. I do not move.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，风吹也不动。
lines.en: I hold perfectly still, even in the wind.

lines.zh: 我的触角贴着身体收好。
lines.en: My antennae are folded close to my body.

lines.zh: 有只鸟在枝头看，我不动。
lines.en: A bird watches from the branch; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我把自己当成一截断枝。
lines.en: I pretend to be a broken twig.

lines.zh: 叶脉的纹路和我腿一样细。
lines.en: The leaf veins are as thin as my legs.
I rock slowly back and forth.

lines.zh: 阳光斜照，我的影子像根棍。
lines.en: In slanting sun my shadow looks like a stick.
Someone can say my name.

lines.zh: 我藏在叶柄后面，等风停。
lines.en: I hide behind the leaf stalk and wait for the wind.

lines.zh: 我的口器很小，吃得很慢。
lines.en: My mouthparts are tiny; I eat slowly.
The sap tastes faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 一根真树枝落在我旁边。
lines.en: A real twig falls down beside me.
You have been looking for me a while, right?
I am right before you, like a twig.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛扫过我了，又回来。
lines.en: Your eyes passed over me, then came back.

lines.zh: 别用手抓，我会断给你看。
lines.en: Do not grab; I will snap off to show you.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，装成被风吹的。
lines.en: I tilt, pretending the wind did it.
Can you count my legs?

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转过来对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, then hold the pose.
Your hands smell of leaves.

lines.zh: 那根木棍不是我，真不是。
lines.en: That stick is not me. Truly.

lines.zh: 你看得越久，我越像树枝。
lines.en: The longer you look, the more I look like a branch.
I lost a leg; I can still walk.
My disguise is broken.
My shell cracked, and fluid seeps out.
I freeze and pass for dead wood.
That blow knocked me crooked.
I fell to the ground, legs still moving.
The wound is on my back, out of sight.
I slowly draw in my six legs.
Did you hit a branch, or me?
I sway twice and straighten up.
That leaf is tender; I smell it.

lines.zh: 你举着叶子，像举着一面旗。
lines.en: You hold up a leaf like a flag.
I creep an inch forward, slowly.
Do not shake it; I need to see the veins.
I eat leaves only, nothing else.
There are no eggs on this leaf.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿伸出去试探。
lines.en: I reach out one leg to test.
The leaf is three inches away, too far.
I am hungry, but more afraid of being seen.
Fine, I will climb over for a few bites.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我就僵成一根棍。
lines.en: One touch and I stiffen into a stick.
My legs are thin; do not press.

lines.zh: 你撞得树枝晃，我差点掉了。
lines.en: You shook the branch; I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我贴在你衣服上，像根线头。
lines.en: I cling to your clothes like a loose thread.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉了我一条腿。
lines.en: That bump cost me a leg.
I slowly crawl off your shoulder.
You crushed a real twig.
I sway twice and steady myself.
Do not pick me up for kindling.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你没发觉。
lines.en: We bumped, and you never noticed.

lines.zh: 她比我更细，也更沉得住。
lines.en: She is thinner than I, and far more patient.

lines.zh: 我们两只一起装成树枝。
lines.en: Together we pass for two branches.
I brush her back with an antenna.

lines.zh: 她动了一下，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: She moved once; only then did I approach.
We sway side by side in the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 叶下的阴影是我们的地方。
lines.en: The shade beneath the leaves is ours.
No one saw us meet.
Her eggs will fall among the dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我守在她旁边，一动不动。
lines.en: I keep by her side, utterly still.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，会有很多小棍。
lines.en: By this time next year, there will be many small sticks.
Careful; my legs will break.

lines.zh: 你会以为手里是根树枝。
lines.en: You will think you are holding a twig.
I curl my legs and play dead.
Not the middle; that is my thorax.
I am still swaying in your hand.

lines.zh: 你举我起来，风都变大了。
lines.en: You lift me, and the wind feels stronger.
Just put me back on a leaf.
My feet cannot grip your skin.

lines.zh: 你把我和木棍一起拿了。
lines.en: You picked me up along with the stick.

lines.zh: 我掉了一小截腿，别找了。
lines.en: I dropped a small leg; do not look for it.

lines.zh: 有东西碰到这根树枝了。
lines.en: Something touched this branch.

lines.zh: 我听见叶子被压的声音。
lines.en: I hear a leaf being crushed.
A shadow is closing in over there.

lines.zh: 我的触角转向那个方向。
lines.en: My antennae turn that way.
A person or a bird? I must see.
This branch is sinking.

lines.zh: 我先不动，看它要做什么。
lines.en: I keep still and watch what it does.
That hand is very close now.

lines.zh: 我收紧腿，准备好掉下去。
lines.en: I tighten my legs, ready to drop.
There is movement on the other side too.
I can tell how heavy the steps are.

lines.zh: 我往叶背那边挪了半寸。
lines.en: I shift half an inch toward the leaf's back.
I have lined myself up with the bark.
You look at me, so I sway once.
My legs overlap the leaf veins.
You reach out; I prepare to shed a leg and run.
I arrange myself at a right angle.
This angle looks most like dead wood.
You circle to the side; I still do not move.
I keep watch on your fingertip.

lines.zh: 树皮上有个洞，我可以钻。
lines.en: There is a hole in the bark I can slip into.
You do not blink, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 风停了，我只好自己装风。
lines.en: The wind stopped, so I must pretend to be it.
I only need to hold out a little longer.
I kick out with a front leg.
This kick is thin, like a needle prick.
I pinch your finger.
There are tiny spines on my legs.
I strike once and spring back.

lines.zh: 这一下力气不大，但很突然。
lines.en: It is not strong, but it is sudden.
I ram you with my whole body.
I struck your knuckle.
After the blow I turn back into a twig.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，只擅长躲。
lines.en: I am not good at fighting, only hiding.

lines.zh: 我从卵壳里爬出来，很细。
lines.en: I crawl out of the egg case, very thin.
The first thing I see is a leaf.

lines.zh: 我生下来就像一截嫩芽。
lines.en: I was born looking like a tender shoot.

lines.zh: 树皮下有一道新的抓痕。
lines.en: There is a new scratch under the bark.

lines.zh: 我爬到枝条上，学着摇晃。
lines.en: I climb onto a branch and learn to sway.

lines.zh: 这里的叶子够我吃很久。
lines.en: The leaves here will feed me a long while.

lines.zh: 风把我吹下去，我又爬上来。
lines.en: The wind blew me off; I climbed back up.

lines.zh: 我的颜色就是树皮的颜色。
lines.en: My color is the color of bark.

lines.zh: 有只鸟看了我一眼，走了。
lines.en: A bird glanced at me and left.

lines.zh: 从此这根枝上多了一节。
lines.en: Now this branch has one more segment.

lines.zh: 火把我的腿烤得卷起来。
lines.en: The flames curl my legs up.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我轻得像叶子。
lines.en: Falling from high, I am light as a leaf.

lines.zh: 我在水里蹬腿，浮不起来。
lines.en: I kick in the water but cannot float.

lines.zh: 一股风把我整根吹飞了。
lines.en: The blast blows me away whole.
The arrow pinned me to the trunk.

lines.zh: 看不见的力气压住了我。
lines.en: An unseen force presses me down.
The leaves turned yellow, and my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，空气里有乐声。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me; music hangs in the air.
Below me there is no tree, no ground.
